purpose: Fixed paired tests of new external volatility information on identical row support
input_policy: VIX, VVIX, VIX9D official daily histories; previous stock trading session only, no forward fill
limitations: Development years were previously inspected; this is a new-information hypothesis, not a fresh holdout.
All stock and external inputs after 2023 are excluded before feature creation and model selection.
Current surviving universe omits delistings and historical membership changes.
Current vendor histories are not vintage snapshots; the prior-session lag mitigates publication timing, not revisions.
Both controls use identical common rows, so their training history differs from the older OHLCV-only experiment.
Signal observations overlap; counts are not independent trials, and block-close drawdown misses intrahorizon losses.
Every starting phase and failed calibration is retained. Gates and thresholds are unchanged.
A development pass only permits shadow review; no model promotion or trading.
